#### 1. rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome 1  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.716)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:11103)

Loss-of-function mutations in SMARCB1 disrupt the activity of the SWI/SNF chromatin remodeling complex, leading to abnormal neural development in MONDO:0013820 and rhabdoid tumors in rhabdoid tumor predisposition syndrome 1.

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in SMARCB1 that are exclusively associated with one disease phenotype and not the other, or evidence that the SWI/SNF complex plays entirely distinct roles in the pathogenesis of each disease. _(variant: Exome Variant Frequency > 0.001 for pathogenic loss-of-function variants in SMARCB1)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of SMARCB1 and the SWI/SNF complex in these distinct diseases could reveal novel therapeutic targets for both neurological disorders and specific cancer types. Modulating SWI/SNF activity might offer a unified therapeutic strategy.
